# Synthetic OVO responses

Hand-written from the response shapes in My-Ovo-Data v1.0.9 and timmo001/ovoenergy. **Not
captured from OVO.** They exercise the parsers alongside `../captured/`, which keeps the
shapes of real responses from `ovo-insights dev capture-fixtures` with every identifier and
value made up. All identifiers are fake: 13-digit numbers deliberately fail the MPAN check
digit.
